name: context-manager
description: On compaction a cheap model (Haiku by default) checkpoints a cumulative summary; fresh summaries are reinjected within a bounded budget, and session_recall searches the verified session transcript for exact old facts.

python.title: Python 3 command
python.description: The command that starts Python 3.9 or newer: python3 on macOS and Linux; python or py on Windows. A full path also works.
